name: context-menu-39
description: A browser bookmarks bar where each chip can be opened, edited, or removed.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Activity as ActivityIcon, BookmarkX as BookmarkXIcon, Link as LinkIcon, Map as MapIcon, Pencil as PencilIcon, Shapes as ShapesIcon, Wallet as WalletIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" const initialBookmarks = [ { title: "Templates", icon: MapIcon }, { title: "Blocks", icon: ActivityIcon }, { title: "Icons", icon: ShapesIcon }, { title: "Pricing", icon: WalletIcon }, ] export default function BookmarksBarMenu() { const [bookmarks, setBookmarks] = React.useState(initialBookmarks) return (
{bookmarks.map((bookmark) => ( {bookmark.title} Open in new tab Open in new window Open in private window Edit bookmark Copy URL setBookmarks((list) => list.filter((b) => b.title !== bookmark.title) ) } > Remove bookmark ))} {bookmarks.length === 0 ? ( No bookmarks ) : null}
) }
